script_name: EasyTube V4.0 — Ad Skip & SponsorBlock & HD Download⬇️🚀 (No Lag)
summary: The script provides ad skipping, SponsorBlock, and HD download features for YouTube. It communicates with two third-party servers: sponsor.ajay.app (SponsorBlock API, widely used) and evdfrance.fr (for video downloads, less known). No evidence of sensitive data collection, code obfuscation, or remote code execution. The main risk is data transmission to third-party endpoints, especially evdfrance.fr, which may receive video URLs or identifiers. Users should be aware of this external data sharing. Overall, the script is well-written and transparent, but the third-party data transmission is a significant privacy consideration.
